name: try_capture_stack
title: Catch an error and its call

origin.description: Evaluate an expression and, if it errors, return the error with the call that was running.

arguments.name: env
arguments.text: The environment to evaluate it in.

origin.details: The returned error carries the calls. create_traceback turns those calls into numbered lines.
origin.value: The value of the expression, or the error with its calls.
